adminSettings.description: Who can get into this area, and how it behaves for you. Settings that affect users live under Platform settings.

administrators.title: Administrators
administrators.description: Everyone who can reach this area, approve a payout or disable an account.
administrators.note: Granting and revoking the admin role is not wired up yet. It is the one action here that cannot be undone from here — a mis-grant hands somebody the payout queue — so it waits for the backend rather than shipping half-working.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Light, dark, or follow your device. Applies to your account only.

security.title: Security
security.description: How administrators sign in and stay signed in.

alerts.title: What reaches you
alerts.description: Which events are worth interrupting you for.

require2fa.label: Require two-factor for administrators
require2fa.description: Every admin must enrol an authenticator before they can reach this area.
require2fa.warning: Worth turning on before payouts go live. One administrator currently has no authenticator enrolled and would be locked out until they set one up.

sessionHours.label: Admin session length
sessionHours.description: How long an administrator stays signed in before being asked again.

alertCeiling.label: Reward pool near its ceiling
alertCeiling.description: When the platform-wide daily ceiling is close to being reached.

alertRisk.label: Critical-risk payout
alertRisk.description: When a request scores high enough to say do not pay without checking.
